source_hashes: Use source_sha256 and frozen_production_sha256 in the preregistration; validation verifies every entry before executing cases.

states.STEADY_TRACKING: No unresolved observable motion obligation; valid speed and completed demand within profile tracking tolerance.
states.HANDOFF_PENDING: Unresolved observable demand, valid measurement, but profile-derived opportunity or expected-progress threshold not yet reached.
states.TRACKING_PROGRESS: Released valid speed shows directional movement above profile floor and frozen R5.2 recovery ratio; later demands remain monitored.
states.TRACKING_FAULT_SUSPECTED: Response opportunity open; expected progress reaches frozen R5.2 suspect minimum without qualified directional progress.
states.TRACKING_FAULT_CONFIRMED: Frozen R5.2 deficit and consecutive qualified-sample rule met; qualifier evidence latches, not a new top-level SafetyState.
states.INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT: Released measurement invalid, stale or missing; epoch/watch context retained; no invalid sample confirms fault.

guards.valid: released measured speed present, quality VALID, released no later than now, and measurement age within frozen profile validity limit
guards.material: absolute command delta reaches frozen profile material_command_delta and profile predicts observable released response
guards.progress: directional released displacement reaches frozen minimum_observable_speed_change and observed/expected progress reaches frozen R5.2 suspect recovery ratio
guards.suspect: watch response is open and expected progress reaches frozen R5.2 suspect minimum without qualified progress
guards.confirm: expected progress reaches frozen R5.2 confirm minimum and progress ratio is below frozen confirm threshold on frozen consecutive qualified valid samples
guards.steady: after qualified progress, absolute current-command versus released-speed error is at most frozen tracking_error_tolerance

response_opening: First profile-scheduled released sample at which command-delay, rate-limit and lag model predict the frozen minimum observable displacement; no universal fixed grace.
sensor_invalid_rule: Display INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT; preserve epoch/watch identity, oldest causal age and prior valid suspicion; invalid samples never increment confirmation.
sensor_recovery_rule: Evaluate first valid released measurement against preserved directional anchor, command and watch age; no fresh handoff grace.
reversal_rule: Re-anchor directional epoch on material reversal; retain unresolved watch and suspicion if prior qualified motion absent.
confirmed_recovery_authority: Restored motion is audit evidence only; existing top-level Safety reset authority controls FAULT clearing.
hardware_portability: State-machine concepts are generic; every numeric threshold/timing comes from the fixture profile and must be recalibrated for real equipment.
blocking_issue: Cumulative same-direction command changes individually below the material threshold are compared only with the immediately previous command; an observable cumulative demand can remain unqualified. Do not port to production Safety before a new registered revision.
